column1: # Phase 3: supported historical partial order for the audited early cascade.
# Only evidence-backed edges appear. There are deliberately NO blanket
# "all nwgmc before all pwgmc" edges: cohorts are determined by adjudicated
# evidence, not by a predetermined permutation. Rules in the same broad stage
# whose mutual chronology is unknown are left unordered.
#   historical_relative_chronology = a dated ordering supported by lexical
#   fst_dependency        = required by the CAPR implementation (rule feeds/bleeds
#   technical_dependency  = a computational placement requirement (stage != order)
#   historical_stage      = ordering implied purely by secure stage precedence
#       (used sparingly; none asserted here without a concrete witness)
# confidence: A = lexically forced / secure ; B = analysis-dependent ; C = unresolved
# "later" endpoints outside the audited set (SC036, SC040, SC043, SC044, SC051,
# SC052, SC063) are named so Phase 4 can honour the boundary.
